Incident Bot: PAGE: svc-inference-prod — elevated 5xx rate detected (P1). Oncall: Elaine. Auto-created incident thread. Pager: <https://pager.example/incident/2013456789|link>.

Elaine: on it. scaling a few replicas, putting service into fallback routing for external traffic. will post mitigation steps in a min. :rotating_light:

Elaine: mitigation 1/3 — scaled inference-workers from 12 -> 28: `kubectl scale deploy inference-workers -n prod --replicas=28`
Elaine: mitigation 2/3 — flipped routing to model-variant v2-fallback for customer-facing traffic: `redwood route set svc-inference-prod --variant v2-fallback`
Elaine: mitigation 3/3 — rolled back commit 0a3f2b that touched batching thresholds: `git revert 0a3f2b` and restarted pods.

Miguel: seeing error spike 03:40–03:52 UTC, 5xxs peaked ~7.8% then dropped to baseline after the scale+rollback. aggregate failed requests ~14k in the window. tail latency also doubled.
Miguel: quick log sample from 03:41:02 showing batching overflow and KV cache misses:
```
[03:41:02.123] ERROR request_id=abc123 shard=4 batching: queue_size=512 > max_batch=256 -> drop
[03:41:02.124] WARN request_id=abc123 kvcache: miss ttl=0 key=op_kv_42
[03:41:02.125] ERROR handler: downstream_retry_limit_exceeded status=500
```

Raj: thanks — can we get a short customer impact summary for support+sales? want to know affected customers, duration, and if any SLA breaches. Plan: schedule post-incident review tomorrow 15:00 UTC. who owns the RCA writeup?

Elaine: I can own initial timeline + draft. will include minute-by-minute timeline, mitigation notes, and candidate contributing factors. aim to have first draft by EOD today.

Julia: support note: flagged 3 enterprise customers with >5% errors (org-101, org-203, org-321). CS is contacting them now, prepping status email template. need a 2-3 sentence public-facing blurb for status page.

Aaron: quick summary of suspected root cause: batching threshold change in commit 0a3f2b caused high queueing under certain sequence-length patterns + KV cache TTL regression allowed cache churn. fallback routing didn't engage earlier due to a model-variant compatibility check failing (variant labels mismatch).
Aaron: reproduction snippet (local):
```
# simulate load with long sequences
python loadtest.py --concurrency 200 --seq-len 1024 --model-variant v2
# observe queue growth > max_batch and OOM-like rejects
```
Aaron: proposed remediation items: add canary for batching param changes, add unit/integration test for sequence-length distributions, tighten the variant compatibility checks, and add an alert if queue_size > max_batch for >30s.

Miguel: agree. add an SLO guard that auto-falls back to the last-known-good variant when error rate for current variant >3% for 2m. I've sketched the alert rule: `alert: VariantErrorSpike if (sum(rate(5xx[1m])) by (variant) / sum(rate(req_total[1m])) by (variant)) > 0.03 for 2m`

Sam: legal/compliance question — any PII or customer data exfiltration risk identified? security ran quick check, no unusual network egress, no logs indicate payload access beyond normal. will have security do a deeper scan but low likelihood.

Raj: good. meeting scheduled: Post-Incident Review — tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Elaine to chair, Aaron+Miguel to present timeline + root-cause evidence, Julia to present customer-impact blurb, Sam to confirm compliance sign-off.

Elaine: initial action items (owners + target):
- Draft RCA timeline (Elaine) — first draft by EOD today, share in this thread
- Revert+hotfix (done) (Elaine) — closed
- Canary tests for batching (Aaron) — PR by EOW
- Variant compatibility check and test (Aaron) — PR by EOW+3
- SLO guard + alert (Miguel) — alert rule + runbook by tomorrow morning
- Customer communications (Julia) — status page blurb + templates by 10:00 UTC
- Compliance scan (Sam) — preliminary OK by EOD, full by next Tue

Raj: please add these to the incident tracker (https://tracker.example/issue/INF-2013456789) and tag `postmortem-schedule`. I'll invite stakeholders.

Elaine: adding tasks now. will post the draft timeline link here when ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Incident Bot: Incident INF-2013456789 updated: status -> mitigated. Postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC.

Elaine: draft timeline link: <https://docs.example/r/INF-2013456789/timeline|timeline doc> — includes console traces, kube events, and initial hypothesis. asking reviewers to leave comments in the doc.

Aaron: review notes I plan to add: quantify sequence-length histogram that triggered queue blowup, attach model-variant label set, and include perf regression plot vs baseline.

Miguel: will add alert rule and a short runbook section: "if queue > max_batch -> toggle fallback route -> scale pods if route fails".

Julia: will post customer-facing blurb here by 10:00 and ping CS.

Sam: I'll formalize the compliance entry in the draft (data-sensitivity: low).

Elaine: thanks team — closing thread for live mitigation. continue RCA comments in the doc. we will merge final sign-off in the postmortem channel after peer review.

Raj: sign-off process: draft -> peer reviews (2 reviewers) -> exec readout -> sign-off. target full sign-off by Mar 18.

Aaron: tagging @Miguel @Elaine for reviewer handoff when draft is ready.

Miguel: ACK.

Julia: ACK.

Sam: ACK.

Incident Bot: thread archived (auto) after mitigation noted.
